title.narrative: Accelerating TB Elimination in Indonesia

description.narrative: Indonesia - Tuberculosis - Directorate General of Disease Prevention and Control, Ministry of Health of The Republic of Indonesia - MOH. This program has the following goals: Accelerate the elimination of tuberculosis in Indonesia by 2030. End tuberculosis epidemic in Indonesia by 2050. The objectives of this program are: Strengthen the management of responsive tuberculosis control in national, provincial, district/municipality, and health care facility level. By 2023 to achieve 90% of TB case notification and 75% of drug resistant TB treatment coverage. Improving TB notification by minimizing disruption of services in facility due to Covid-19 pandemic. Increase the quality of TB services which centered in the community needs. To achieve 90% and 80% of treatment success rate of drug sensitive TB and drug resistant TB respectively before 2023. Increase access of the community on tuberculosis control and prevention. To cover 80% of under 5 household contacts of bacteriologically confirmed TB patients and 50% of PLHIV under ART with TB preventive treatment before 2023. Increase demand and interest of the community on controling and preventing tuberculosis. To cover all TB-HIV co-infected patients with ARV in 2023. To ensure 75% TB patients know their HIV status in 2023, with the support of communities
